_about: How good the wind is for a downwind run, per wind station, in the degrees that station reports. Ranges run clockwise from..to inclusive (330 to 10 wraps through north); the first range holding a reading wins; a direction in none is nogo; under floor kn is light. Read by the downwind.pro site (web/lib/components/wind-quality.js) and by Node-RED's run rating (fetched from GitHub). Edit here only.

kihei.about: Dustin 2026-10-16: the magical 340, pretty good 350, more difficult 15. Run data: 330-347 goes best, 350-015 about average, runs stop past ~020. Reverse (south) runs go better at 180-195 than 200+.

hookipa.about: Rough, from run data until Dustin gives ranges: 70-100 all go about the same (90s a touch faster), 60s go noticeably worse, runs stop below 60.
